# GPS Dock Modifications

> **[Unverified]** This page rests on a single community report. Cross-check before relying on it.

> Items marked **[Partial]** are only partly confirmed by the source and need more work. They stay in the review queue and are firmed up, corrected or removed as more sources come in.

## Summary

[Partial] Separate the lid, shave tabs, bore holes, splice wires, and install the GPS dock. [t1000]

## Tools

- [Partial] Xacto knife or razor blade [t1000]
- [Partial] Dremel tool (optional) [t1000]
- [Partial] Sharp pocket knife (optional) [t1000]

- Sandpaper [t1000]
- [Partial] Soldering iron [t1000]
- [Partial] Heat shrink tubing [t1000]

## Tips & gotchas

- Use scissors to cut the cradle tab and sandpaper to smooth it. [t1000]
- Remove the bottom tray entirely rather than Dremeling it out for easier access. [t1000]
- [Partial] Use a power source with step-down circuitry in the middle for direct splicing. [t1000]
